author: LGR
description:
Finally diving into the world of home pinball thanks to Stern loaning me this review table! I'm new to this so the video is all from the perspective of a first-timer: receiving and unboxing it, the assembly and setup process, and of course testing it out and learning the gameplay ins and outs. Plus exploring some modern pinball features for the first time, many of which still feel kinda wild to me (Wi-Fi OTA updates, online leaderboards, achievements, etc.)
